description: Beyond the Press is the sister channel to the Hydraulic Press Channel, run by a Finnish workshop owner and his wife. The videos go beyond simple crushing to feature large-scale destructive experiments, like exploding overinflated tires, detonating fireworks, or firing projectiles, often with a focus on engineering and workshop fabrication. It also includes behind-the-scenes looks at machining, building tools, and creative DIY projects that test the limits of materials and machines.
